titulo: Park on These Tracks and Something Pushes Your Car | Urban Legend #Shorts
titulo_pt: Para o carro nesses trilhos e algo empurra ele | Lenda urbana
resumo_pt: Lenda dos trilhos fantasmas. Na cidade do narrador dizem que, se você para o carro em ponto morto em cima de um trilho velho, ele é empurrado pra fora. O narrador testa com talco no porta-malas pra ver as marcas. O carro anda sozinho morro acima e sai dos trilhos segundos antes do trem passar. Atrás, no talco, aparecem dezenas de mãozinhas de criança: as crianças do ônibus escolar que morreram ali há muitos anos.
descricao:
They say the tracks are haunted. But not the way you think.

Would you try it?

scenes.text: Every kid in my town knew about the old railroad crossing.
scenes.pt: Toda criança da minha cidade conhecia a passagem de trem velha.
scenes.visual: old railroad crossing on a country road at night, one dim streetlight

scenes.text: Stop your car on the tracks. Put it in neutral. And wait.
scenes.pt: Para o carro em cima dos trilhos. Põe em ponto morto. E espera.
scenes.visual: car stopped on railroad tracks at night, headlights on

scenes.text: They said the car would start moving on its own. Uphill.
scenes.pt: Diziam que o carro começava a andar sozinho. Morro acima.
scenes.visual: railroad tracks crossing a small hill road at night

scenes.text: So I covered my trunk in baby powder, parked on the tracks, and waited.
scenes.pt: Então cobri o porta-malas de talco, parei nos trilhos e esperei.
scenes.visual: white baby powder spread over the trunk of a dark car

scenes.text: Then, in the distance, I heard a train horn.
scenes.pt: Aí, ao longe, ouvi a buzina de um trem.
scenes.visual: single train headlight far away on dark tracks

scenes.text: I grabbed the key. The car wouldn't start.
scenes.pt: Peguei a chave. O carro não pegava.
scenes.visual: hand turning a car key, dashboard lights flickering

scenes.text: Then the car started rolling. Slowly. Uphill. Off the tracks.
scenes.pt: Aí o carro começou a andar. Devagar. Morro acima. Pra fora dos trilhos.
scenes.visual: car rolling slowly off railroad tracks at night, nobody pushing

scenes.text: One second later, the train roared past right behind me.
scenes.pt: Um segundo depois, o trem passou rugindo logo atrás de mim.
scenes.visual: freight train rushing past a railroad crossing at night, motion blur

scenes.text: The baby powder was covered in handprints.
scenes.pt: O talco estava coberto de marcas de mão.
scenes.visual: dozens of small handprints in white powder on the trunk of a car

scenes.text: Small ones. Dozens of them. Children's hands.
Years ago, a school bus stalled on those tracks.
scenes.pt: Anos atrás, um ônibus escolar morreu naqueles trilhos.
scenes.visual: old black and white photo of a yellow school bus on a country road

scenes.text: Nobody pushed them off. So now, they push everyone else.
scenes.pt: Ninguém empurrou eles pra fora. Então agora, eles empurram todo mundo.
scenes.visual: railroad crossing at dawn, small handprints in powder on a car

personagens: the narrator is a young man with a buzz cut and a black hoodie driving an old blue sedan; his dad has a gray mustache; the ghosts are small children seen only as tiny handprints
